# Tiered storage

<Callout variant="note">
TODO: This section is a placeholder. Tiered storage content to be added.
</Callout>

Tiered storage allows you to automatically move older data to more cost-effective storage tiers while maintaining query access.

## Overview

Tiered storage vs. Tiger Lake:
- **Tiered Storage**: Automatic data movement between hot and cold storage
- **Tiger Lake**: Long-term archival storage
